author: /root/theme_a_coverage
scope: Theme A; exact guidance compared to actual adapted prompt/solution evidence; no claim of whole-syllabus completion from linked counts.
method: Human review of exact source guidance and selected actual prompt/solution evidence per objective. All linked candidates enumerated, but exhaustive per-record marking QA is not claimed. A gap is recorded conservatively as not established by reviewed evidence; unmapped candidate discovery can change it. May-include lists remain non-exhaustive.

objectives.statement: Describe the functions and interactions of the main CPU components.
guidance_paragraphs: • Units: arithmetic logic unit (ALU), control unit (CU)
• Registers: instruction register (IR), program counter (PC), memory address register (MAR), memory data register (MDR), accumulator (AC)
• Buses: address, data, control
• Processors: single core processor, multi-core processor, co-processors
• A diagrammatic representation of the relationship between the specified CPU components

reviewed_evidence.finding: Explicit address/data/control bus roles on memory read.
Parallel independent tasks with more suitable CPU cores.

bullet_findings.guidance: • Units: arithmetic logic unit (ALU), control unit (CU)
bullet_findings.finding: ALU/CU functions assessed; interactions narrower than complete architecture.

bullet_findings.guidance: • Registers: instruction register (IR), program counter (PC), memory address register (MAR), memory data register (MDR), accumulator (AC)
bullet_findings.finding: MDR assessed repeatedly; PC, MAR, IR and accumulator functions not established by selected evidence.

bullet_findings.guidance: • Buses: address, data, control
bullet_findings.finding: All three buses explicitly assessed on a read.

bullet_findings.guidance: • Processors: single core processor, multi-core processor, co-processors
bullet_findings.finding: Multiple cores partly assessed; single-core/co-processor distinction not established.

bullet_findings.guidance: • A diagrammatic representation of the relationship between the specified CPU components
bullet_findings.finding: No linked reviewed task asks a CPU relationship diagram.

remaining_gaps: CPU register interactions and diagrammatic architecture; single/multi/co-processor distinctions.
objectives.next_action: Design substantive questions for remaining gaps; independent coordinator review of findings before master integration.

• Real-world scenarios may include video games, artificial intelligence (AI), large simulations and other applications that require graphics rendering and machine learning.

bullet_findings.guidance: • The architecture that allows graphics processing units (GPUs) to handle specific tasks and makes them suitable for complex computations
bullet_findings.finding: Parallel operations assessed; description of many simpler cores could be more explicit.

bullet_findings.finding: Rendering, simulation and ML contexts represented; may-include examples are not a mandatory exhaustive checklist.

remaining_gaps: Strengthen explicit GPU architectural explanation; retain contextual medium/high demand.
objectives.next_action: Design substantive questions for remaining gaps; independent coordinator review of findings before master integration.
